name: Bisping & Bisping high-security data center, Lauf an der Pegnitz
notes: Company page says it offers server housing across data centers in Lauf, Nuremberg, Frankfurt and Munich; Nürnberger Nachrichten visited the Laufer company's high-security data center.

name: Synaforce / former Hartl Group Hofkirchen data center
notes: Synaforce states its Hofkirchen data center is Tier3+ and powered with renewable electricity; Landkreis Passau documents the 2016 inauguration of the Hartl Group data center in Hofkirchen.

name: Bavarian Green Data Center, University of Passau
developer: University of Passau; Bavarian State Ministry for Digital Affairs
notes: Official state and university releases describe a cooperation agreement for the Bavarian Green Data Center model project on the University of Passau campus, with a prefabricated expandable server container and greenhouse heat reuse; ministry funding around EUR 3 million.

name: Siebenecken / Förnbacher Forst solar-linked data center project
developer: Bürgerenergiegenossenschaft (solar project); data center developer not stated
notes: Donaukurier reports two large solar park projects near Pfaffenhofen, including a Förnbacher Forst / Siebenecken project whose electricity is to be used directly for a data center; article says size is still unclear.

name: Ignis Energy Wenzenbach AI/HPC data center
notes: Trade press reports Ignis Energy plans an AI/HPC data center at Abbachhof in Wenzenbach, northeast of Regensburg, with up to 300 MW grid connection; tied to nearby grid reinforcement but legally separate from the substation project.

name: R-KOM Datacenter Ostbayern 3, Lappersdorf
notes: R-KOM announced the opening of its third Datacenter Ostbayern site in the Regensburg north area in September 2023; TÜV certificate/search-indexed facility records place RZ3 at Keltenstraße 56, 93138 Lappersdorf.

name: R-KOM Datacenter Ostbayern 1, Regensburg
notes: R-KOM official page describes three redundant data-center locations in the Regensburg area; facility directories identify Ostbayern 1 at Straubinger Straße 50, 93055 Regensburg.

name: R-KOM Datacenter Ostbayern 2, Regensburg
notes: R-KOM official page describes three redundant data-center locations in the Regensburg area; facility directories identify Ostbayern 2 at Straubinger Straße 48, 93055 Regensburg.

name: Vautron Rechenzentrum Regensburg
notes: Vautron's official page describes its Regensburg data center offering server, cloud and colocation services; company imprint gives Obermünsterstraße 9, 93047 Regensburg.

name: InterNetX ISO-certified data center
notes: InterNetX says it operates its own ISO-certified data center with colocation service; its fact sheet describes a Tier 3 ISO 27001 data center, and company contact page lists headquarters at Johanna-Dachs-Straße 55, 93055 Regensburg.

name: University of Regensburg Campus IT / Rechenzentrum
notes: University announcement states its Rechenzentrum celebrated 50 years and was renamed Campus IT in June 2026; contact page lists the Rechenzentrum building on the Regensburg campus.

name: City of Regensburg data center container
notes: Prior1 reference case says it delivered an IT container with emergency power, electrical supply, free-cooling concept and security technology for Stadt Regensburg; construction year listed as 2020.

name: Landratsamt Rhön-Grabfeld / Interkomm-IT municipal data center
notes: Landkreis page says the Landratsamt has had its own data center since 2017 and that Interkomm-IT took it over in 2020; another Landkreis notice says the school municipal data center was to be upgraded with digital education funding.
